thread:
Samir Patel: quick thread for ACME POC. they want: doc search + invoice/create actions (tool calls). Sales asked for an SOW, success metrics, model recommendations, and an estimated monthly $$ for ~10k q/day. short deadline: demo in 12 business days.

Nina Gomez: suggested success metrics: top5 precision >= 0.80 on labeled eval set, >95% successful tool-call payloads (correctly formatted & validated), mean search path latency < 450ms under 95th pct load, and automated redaction of detected PII for results sent to frontend.

Evan K.: model fit notes: large docs -> recommend testing 32k-context family. If budget constrained, evaluate 16k then 8k. For rerank: two-stage pipeline preferred: ANN index (faiss/hnsw) -> small neural reranker (cheap) -> generator for tool formatting. Consider quantized 8-bit for reranker to save cost.

Priya S.: timeline breakdown (realistic): Day0-3 ingest/parsing + tests for doc connectors; Day4-7 embed + index + sample recall checks; Day8-9 reranker tuning + prompt templates; Day10-11 tool integration + E2E smoke; Day12 demo + acceptance. we need 50 canonical prompts from customer by Day3.

Samir Patel: acceptance criteria in SOW draft: (1) precision@5 >= 0.8 on customer test set (2) avg token cost per query <= $0.004 (hosted) or provided committed rate for reserved capacity (3) E2E tool-call success >= 95% (4) no security findings blocking demo. fallback: degrade to 8k context & add explicit chunking if cost or latency fails.

Nina Gomez: security ask from ACME: SCIM + SSO (SAML), BYOK (KMS integration), audit log retention 12 months, SOC2 report, and a filled security questionnaire. They'll return the questionnaire by COB. add breach/contact SLA into SOW.

Evan K.: embedding sizing: ACME estimate ~180k docs, mean 2.8KB -> ~504M tokens. Start with 768d embeddings; if recall low, try 1024d. Index storage ~15-25GB compressed depending on method. Recommend nightly incremental refresh; customer asked for same-day updates but we'll propose daily snapshot + webhook for high-priority docs.

Priya S.: pricing proposal options to finance: Option A (hosted): $0.XX per 1k search+gen units with burst cap, Option B (reserved): monthly commit for reserved throughput + lower unit cost + SLA. Need finance numbers. We should include an example invoice: at 10k q/day -> ~300k q/mo, show tiered pricing.

Samir Patel: engineering checklist items: 1) verify 32k model latency on sample doc set, 2) instrument token-level cost metric, 3) implement rerank A/B flags, 4) add validation for tool-call outputs (schema checks).

Evan K.: sample curl for search + rerank (POC engineer):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/semsearch
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"query":"How do I dispute an invoice charge?","top_k":50,"rerank":true,"model":"rwd-32k-search"}'
```

Nina Gomez: ops question: who owns embeddings refresh policy? we should document that in SOW (daily incremental by default, manual immediate refresh via webhook). Also add retention policy for snapshots and index TTL.

InfraBot: ACME-POC-2124601234 created, infra ticket INF-8821 opened, service account provisioned, KMS integration pending authorization.

Samir Patel: blockers to surface on next call: (1) security questionnaire completion, (2) finance to confirm commit pricing for 10k q/day, (3) SSO/testing credentials from ACME, (4) model latency on 32k not validated yet.

Priya S.: I'll put together the SOW draft tonight including timeline, acceptance criteria, rollback plan, and prompt-eval plan (we require 50 labeled prompts across 6 intents). Will add rollback to 16k/8k + chunking.

Evan K.: one more: propose we collect these metrics during POC: precision@1/5, recall@10, avg tokens per query, token cost, 95th pct latency, tool-call success rate, and PII redaction false positive/neg rate.

Samir Patel: great. next sync Thu 10am PT. Nina/Evan/Priya please add any missing SOW bits in the doc. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
